description: Run multi-oracle price analytics: consensus across providers, batch reads, historical series, cross-chain spreads, deviation, correlation or a risk summary. Use it when one price is not enough and the caller needs to compare, stress or trend oracle data. Do not use it for a single provider spot read (get_oracle_price) or for feed uptime (get_oracle_health). Returns the requested analysis rows plus provider participation and reference prices. Deprecated alias: prefer trade_guard with op "price_analytics". Removed on 2027-01-06.

assets.description: Assets to analyse; consensus/risk/history use the first asset

mode.description: consensus = cross-provider price, batch = multi-asset, history = time series

providers.description: Required for metric=risk; otherwise uses the provider default

name: get_price_analytics
